title: sql-dialect-fmt.toml
description: Configuration for sql-dialect-fmt (the nearest sql-dialect-fmt.toml found by walking up from each input). Every key is optional.

line_width.description: Target line width the printer tries to stay within before wrapping.

indent_width.description: Spaces per indentation level. `tab_width` is accepted as an alias.

keyword_case.description: Letter case for recognized SQL keywords.

data_type_case.description: Letter case for built-in data-type words in type positions.

function_case.description: Letter case for recognized function names.

identifier_case.description: Letter case for unquoted identifiers that are not keywords, types, or functions.

logical_operator_newline.description: Where AND/OR sit when a boolean expression wraps.

dense_operators.description: Pack binary operators without surrounding spaces.

use_tabs.description: Indent with tab characters instead of spaces.

newline_before_semicolon.description: Place the statement-terminating semicolon on its own line.

lines_between_queries.description: Force this many blank lines between top-level statements. Leave unset to preserve the author's grouping.

expression_width.description: Flat width cap for parenthesized lists before they wrap. Leave unset to use `line_width`.

line_ending.description: Output line endings. Auto preserves the first line ending found in the input.

comma_style.description: Placement of commas in wrapped comma-separated lists.

dialect.description: SQL dialect to parse and format. Aliases such as oracle, tsql, postgres, and presto are also accepted.

params.description: Placeholder values replaced after formatting, in order of appearance.

param_types.description: Override which placeholder spellings the lexer recognizes. Unset flags keep the dialect default.

exclude.description: Glob patterns skipped during recursive directory discovery.
